source_rights_audit.blocker_summary: CODAL's published terms of use could not be retrieved from the audit environment on 2026-08-21 (connection timeout, no HTTP response, on both https://www.codal.ir/ and https://www.codal.ir/Rules.aspx), so the redistribution terms governing the compiled CODAL-derived factual fields remain genuinely unresolved. Separately, the approved manuscript states that the company-level source data are not openly redistributable. Neither point was resolved by this action.

manuscript_boundary.why_the_manuscript_is_unchanged: No public DOI exists, so the manuscript must continue to describe the dataset according to its present availability. Updating it before a DOI exists would make the manuscript state something untrue, and the approved manuscript is byte-pinned to a completed human review that a change would invalidate.

release_candidate_conflict_resolution: The conflict is left standing and visible rather than resolved in either direction. The manuscript keeps its present, truthful restricted-access description because nothing is published; the release candidate records the authors' publication intent without acting on it. Reconciling the two requires (a) resolving the CODAL terms question and (b) a separate authorized manuscript action once a DOI actually exists.

superseded_marker.why_the_previous_pointer_is_not_marked_c: The six human-supplied manuscript submission items are still outstanding. This action supplied dataset-release metadata for a Zenodo candidate, which is not the same surface and does not fill any manuscript placeholder. The pointer advances because a prepared candidate now needs a human digest review first; the manuscript metadata remains outstanding and is republished as such.
